facts.text: In 2022 Guirio scored the extra-time winner that gave Nantes their first Coupe de France in futsal.
He won the French futsal championship with Laval in 2024 and 2025.

Achraf Hakimi.why: Achraf Hakimi is a right-back famous for his speed and his attacking runs. He races up the wing to join attacks, delivers crosses and even scores goals, then sprints back to defend. Born in Spain, he chose to play for Morocco. Kids can learn from his engine; full-backs who can run all game help their team in both boxes, so build up your fitness and your love of running.

learn.text: Hakimi often overlaps down the right to deliver the ball. Practise running past your winger on the outside, taking the pass in your stride, and crossing low and hard across the goal.

facts.text: Hakimi came through Real Madrid's youth teams and won the Champions League with them in 2018. He later won it again with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026.
He helped Morocco win the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations and was named African Footballer of the Year for 2025.

Alejandro Balde.why: Alejandro Balde is a Spanish left-back known for his pace and his fearless running down the wing. He came through Barcelona's famous academy and broke into the first team as a teenager. He loves to overlap, beat defenders with speed and deliver the ball into the box. Kids can learn from his bravery; when you see space in front of you, run into it with confidence.

learn.text: Balde beats defenders with a burst of speed. Practise pushing the ball a few steps past the defender and sprinting after it, keeping the ball under control as you accelerate.

facts.text: Balde started at Espanyol before joining Barcelona's academy in 2011, when he was a young boy.
He has won La Liga with Barcelona three times, in 2023, 2025 and 2026, as of November 2026.

Alessandro Bastoni.why: Alessandro Bastoni is an Italian centre-back known for his passing, his speed and his ability to play in different roles. He is left-footed and often steps forward with the ball to start attacks, sometimes even running into midfield or out wide. That makes him a modern defender who helps his team build play. Kids can learn from his confidence on the ball; defenders can be playmakers too.

learn.text: Bastoni often carries the ball forward from defence. Practise receiving from your keeper, dribbling into the space in front of you when no one presses, and then passing to a teammate further up.

facts.text: Bastoni won Euro 2020 with Italy. With Inter Milan he has won Serie A three times, in 2021, 2024 and 2026, as of November 2026.
He was named Serie A's Best Defender for both the 2023-24 and 2024-25 seasons.

Alexander Isak.why: Alexander Isak is a tall, skilful Swedish striker who is unusually good at dribbling for his size. He glides past defenders, finishes calmly and can score with either foot. He likes to drop deep or drift wide before bursting into the box. Kids can learn from his calm finishing; when you are through on goal, pick your spot and place the ball rather than blasting it.

learn.text: Isak stays calm in front of goal. Practise dribbling at a cone defender, slipping past it, and then side-footing a shot into the corner of the goal, away from the keeper.

facts.text: Isak began his career at his boyhood club AIK in Stockholm. He is the youngest-ever goalscorer for both AIK and the Sweden national team.
He won the Copa del Rey with Real Sociedad and was its top scorer in 2019-20. Later he won the EFL Cup with Newcastle United in 2025.

Alisson.why: Alisson is a Brazilian goalkeeper known for his calm, his one-on-one saves and his great passing. He stays big and patient when attackers are through, so they often run out of ideas. He is also excellent with his feet and can start attacks with long, accurate passes. Kids can learn from his calm; a goalkeeper who stays relaxed helps the whole defence stay relaxed too.

learn.text: Alisson is famous for winning one-on-ones. Practise coming off your line as an attacker gets close, staying on your feet as long as possible, and spreading wide only at the last moment.

facts.text: Alisson joined Internacional's academy in 2002 and won the Campeonato Gaúcho in each of his four seasons in the first team there.
In 2019 he won the Champions League with Liverpool and the Copa América with Brazil, and was named The Best FIFA Goalkeeper.

Alphonso Davies.why: Alphonso Davies is a Canadian left-back nicknamed "the Roadrunner" for his amazing speed. He can recover from almost any position and loves to dribble past defenders and attack down the wing. He can also play further forward as a left midfielder, which is why he is so good going forward. Kids can learn from his speed and his willingness to defend; use your pace to help your team at both ends.

learn.text: Davies uses his speed to get back and defend. Practise sprinting back towards your goal when an attacker gets past, getting goal-side first, and then turning to face them.

facts.text: Davies was the first player born in the 2000s to play in a Major League Soccer match, for the Vancouver Whitecaps.
After joining Bayern Munich, he won the Champions League with them in 2020 and has won the Bundesliga many times, as of November 2026.

Antonio Rüdiger.why: Antonio Rüdiger is a German centre-back known for his speed, strength and fierce tackling. He loves a battle with a striker and is very hard to get past. He also runs forward with the ball when he sees space, and he brings huge energy to his team. Kids can learn from his determination; be brave in duels and never give up on a ball.

learn.text: Rüdiger uses his speed to stay close to attackers. Practise jockeying a dribbler, staying close enough to touch them, and timing your tackle for the moment the ball is away from their feet.

facts.text: Rüdiger began his career at VfB Stuttgart and later won the FA Cup, the Europa League and the Champions League with Chelsea.
After joining Real Madrid in 2022, he won La Liga and a second Champions League title in 2024. With Germany he won the 2017 Confederations Cup.

Bruno Fernandes.why: Bruno Fernandes is a Portuguese attacking midfielder famous for his creativity, his long-range shooting and his penalties. He is always looking for the forward pass that creates a chance, even if it is risky. He has a huge work rate and keeps going for the whole game. Kids can learn from his ambition; look for the pass that can create a goal, not just the safe one.

learn.text: Fernandes plays quick, sharp passes in tight spaces. Practise passing against a wall with both feet, controlling the rebound with one touch and passing again as fast as you can.

facts.text: Fernandes played in Italy for five years before joining Sporting CP. He was named Primeira Liga Player of the Year in both of his full seasons there.
With Manchester United he won the EFL Cup in 2023 and the FA Cup in 2024. With Portugal he has won the Nations League twice.

Bukayo Saka.why: Bukayo Saka is an English winger who grew up in Arsenal's academy and became one of their most important players. He likes to start wide on the right, cut inside onto his strong left foot and shoot or pass. He is brave on the ball and keeps trying even when defenders double up on him. Kids can learn from his humble, hard-working attitude; the best players keep practising and stay kind to their teammates.

learn.text: Saka loves to run at his defender. Practise one-against-one games where you drive at the defender, use a quick change of direction to get past, then pass or shoot with your stronger foot.

facts.text: Saka joined Arsenal's Hale End academy at the age of seven. He won the FA Cup with Arsenal in 2020 and the Premier League with them in 2025-26.
He was named England Men's Player of the Year two seasons in a row, for 2021-22 and 2022-23.

Cole Palmer.why: Cole Palmer is an English attacking midfielder who came through Manchester City's academy. He is known for his calm dribbling, his clever passes and his cool finishing, especially from the penalty spot. He often looks relaxed even in the biggest games, which helps him make good choices. Kids can learn from his calm mind; slow your breathing, look up, and pick the best option instead of rushing.

learn.text: Palmer often receives the ball between the lines and turns to face goal. Practise checking over your shoulder before the pass arrives, then take your first touch away from the defender and turn towards goal.

facts.text: With Manchester City he won the Champions League, the Premier League and the FA Cup in 2022-23, and he won the 2023 European Under-21 Championship with England.
With Chelsea he won the Conference League in 2025 and the FIFA Club World Cup in 2025, where he was given the Golden Ball.

Cristian Romero.why: Cristian Romero, often called Cuti, is an Argentine centre-back known for his fierce competitive spirit. He reads the game well, steps out to win the ball early and is strong in duels. He became a key part of the Argentina team that won almost everything in the early 2020s. Kids can learn from his determination; a defender who never gives up on a tackle makes life hard for every attacker.

learn.text: Romero likes to step in front of his striker and win the ball before it arrives. Practise watching the passer, timing your step forward and getting your body between the attacker and the ball.

facts.text: Romero won the 2022 FIFA World Cup with Argentina, plus the Copa América in 2021 and 2024.
With Tottenham Hotspur he won the UEFA Europa League in 2025.

Dani Carvajal.why: Dani Carvajal is a Spanish right-back who spent most of his career at Real Madrid, where he grew up as a youth player. He is a tough, clever defender who also loves to attack down the wing. He is famous for always being ready for the biggest nights in European football. Kids can learn from his consistency; doing the simple jobs well, every game, is what makes a player trusted.

learn.text: Carvajal is quick to sprint back after joining an attack. Practise a game where you overlap to attack, and as soon as your team loses the ball, race back to get between the ball and your own goal.

facts.text: Carvajal won the UEFA Champions League six times with Real Madrid, the last of them in 2024.
With Spain he won the European Under-19 Championship in 2011, the Under-21 Championship in 2013 and the senior Euro 2024.

David Raya.why: David Raya is a Spanish goalkeeper who was born in Barcelona but started his professional career in England, at Blackburn Rovers. He is known for his calm passing, which lets his team build attacks from the back, and for steady shot-stopping. He worked his way up from the lower leagues to the very top. Kids can learn from his patience; keep improving step by step, wherever you start.

learn.text: Raya is comfortable with the ball at his feet. Practise receiving a back-pass, taking a touch out of your feet and passing firmly to a teammate's stronger foot, before an attacker can close you down.

facts.text: Raya won the Premier League Golden Glove three times, for 2023-24, 2024-25 (shared) and 2025-26.
He was part of the Spain squads that won Euro 2024 and the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Declan Rice.why: Declan Rice is an English midfielder who came through West Ham's academy and later captained the club. He is known for his stamina, his tackling and the way he carries the ball forward through midfield. He can protect the defence and also score big goals. Kids can learn from his work rate; covering ground for your team is a skill you can train like any other.

learn.text: Rice is always in the right spot to help a teammate. Practise a two-against-two game where one of you presses the ball and the other stays a few steps behind as cover, then swap jobs.

facts.text: Rice captained West Ham to the UEFA Europa Conference League title in 2023 and was named the competition's Player of the Season.
He played for the Republic of Ireland at youth and senior level before changing to England in 2019.

Désiré Doué.why: Désiré Doué is a French attacking player who came through the Rennes academy. He is a skilful dribbler who can play in the middle or out wide, and he likes to take on defenders and create chances. He played a big part in a very successful spell for Paris Saint-Germain. Kids can learn from his fearless dribbling; when you have space, be brave and run at your defender.

learn.text: Doué keeps the ball close in tight spaces. Practise dribbling in a busy square with lots of other players, using small touches with both feet and lifting your head to find gaps.

facts.text: Doué won the UEFA Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026, and was named the competition's Young Player of the Season for 2024-25.
He won the European Under-17 Championship with France in 2022 and an Olympic silver medal in 2024.

Diogo Costa.why: Diogo Costa is a Portuguese goalkeeper who came through Porto's youth teams and later became the club's captain. He is tall, quick off his line and very good with the ball at his feet. He is especially famous for saving penalties. Kids can learn from his calm under pressure; in a shootout, stay still for as long as you can and trust your reactions.

learn.text: Costa is always set when the shot comes. Practise quick side-steps across your goal, then stop with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands ready just before your partner shoots.

facts.text: At Euro 2024 he saved all three Slovenia penalties in a shootout, the first goalkeeper ever to do that at a European Championship.
He won the UEFA Youth League with Porto in 2019 and the Nations League with Portugal in 2025.

Emiliano Martínez.why: Emiliano Martínez, known as Dibu, is an Argentine goalkeeper who spent many years waiting for his chance, going out on loan to several clubs. When he finally became a number one, he turned into one of the most famous keepers in the world, especially in penalty shootouts. Kids can learn from his patience; keep training hard even when you are not picked, because your chance can come.

learn.text: Martínez makes himself big against attackers. Practise coming off your line towards the ball as your partner dribbles in, staying on your feet and spreading wide so the shooter sees very little goal.

facts.text: Martínez won the 2022 FIFA World Cup with Argentina and was given the Golden Glove as the tournament's best goalkeeper.
He also won the Copa América in 2021 and 2024 and the Yashin Trophy in 2023 and 2024.

Erling Haaland.why: Erling Haaland is a Norwegian striker famous for his speed, strength and finishing. He is always looking for space behind the defence and he arrives in the box at exactly the right moment. As a child he played many sports, including handball and athletics, which helped his balance and power. Kids can learn from him that trying lots of sports can make you a better athlete.

learn.text: Haaland scores many goals by being first to the ball in the box. Practise a finishing game where, after every shot, you sprint in to follow up any save or rebound.

facts.text: In 2022-23 he set Premier League records with 36 league goals and 52 goals in all competitions in one season, and won the Champions League with Manchester City.
At the 2019 Under-20 World Cup he scored a record nine goals in a single match.

Federico Valverde.why: Federico Valverde is a Uruguayan midfielder who started at Peñarol and later became a captain at Real Madrid. He is known for his huge engine, covering the whole pitch, and for his powerful long-range shooting. He will play wherever his coach needs him, even at right-back. Kids can learn from his team-first attitude; being willing to help in any position makes you valuable.

learn.text: Valverde loves to strike from outside the box. Practise shooting from the edge of the area, keeping your head over the ball and following through towards the target so the shot stays low and hard.

facts.text: Valverde won the UEFA Champions League with Real Madrid in 2022 and 2024.
His old nickname was Pajarito, meaning baby bird, but he now calls himself Halcón, meaning falcon.

Florian Wirtz.why: Florian Wirtz is a German attacking midfielder who made his name at Bayer Leverkusen. He sees passes that other players miss, dribbles in tight spaces and arrives in the box to score. He can play in the middle or drift out to the left. Kids can learn from his vision; keep looking around before the ball reaches you so you already know your next pass.

learn.text: Wirtz always knows what is around him. Practise checking over both shoulders before you receive, calling out what you see, then playing your first pass straight away into the free space.

facts.text: He was the youngest scorer in Bundesliga history when he scored for Leverkusen as a teenager.
Wirtz helped Leverkusen win an unbeaten league and cup double in 2023-24, and was named German Footballer of the Year for 2025.

Gabriel Magalhães.why: Gabriel Magalhães is a Brazilian centre-back, often known simply as Gabriel. He is strong, left-footed and very hard to beat in a duel. He is also a big threat from attacking set pieces. He moved to Europe young and played in France and Croatia before becoming a key defender for Arsenal. Kids can learn from his toughness; stand strong, stay balanced, and win your duels fairly.

learn.text: Gabriel stays close and strong against his striker. Practise defending a one-against-one where you stay on your toes, keep the attacker in front of you and use your body to guide them away from goal.

facts.text: Gabriel won the Croatian league and cup with Dinamo Zagreb in 2017-18.
He won the Premier League title with Arsenal in the 2025-26 season.

Gianluigi Donnarumma.why: Gianluigi Donnarumma is an Italian goalkeeper who came through AC Milan's youth teams and played in their first team very young. He is very tall, with long arms and quick reflexes, and he is a big shot-stopper in one-on-ones and shootouts. He later became Italy's captain. Kids can learn from his focus; a keeper must stay ready for the one big save the team needs.

learn.text: Donnarumma has very safe hands. Practise catching shots at chest height with your hands in a W shape behind the ball, then low shots with your hands making a basket, and hold every catch.

facts.text: Donnarumma won Euro 2020 with Italy and was named Player of the Tournament, a rare honour for a goalkeeper.
He won the Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and the Yashin Trophy in 2021 and 2025.

Gregor Kobel.why: Gregor Kobel is a Swiss goalkeeper who played for several German clubs before becoming Borussia Dortmund's number one. He is quick, agile and brave, and good at sweeping up behind his defence. He is also calm with the ball at his feet. Kids can learn from his steady improvement; he kept moving to new challenges and kept getting better.

learn.text: Kobel moves his feet quickly to get in line with the ball. Practise shuffling across your goal as a partner moves the ball, then setting your feet and making the save as they shoot.

facts.text: In the 2023-24 Champions League he helped Dortmund reach the final, the first Swiss goalkeeper to get that far.
He was named in the Champions League Team of the Season for 2023-24.

Harry Kane.why: Harry Kane is an English striker and England captain who is famous for his finishing with both feet. He is more than a goalscorer, though; he often drops deep to pick up the ball and play long passes to faster teammates. He was loaned to several smaller clubs before he became a star. Kids can learn from his practice habits; he worked on his shooting again and again.

learn.text: Kane often drops deep and sets up a teammate. Practise receiving with your back to goal, laying the ball off to a partner, then spinning to get on the end of their return pass.

facts.text: As of November 2026, Kane is England's all-time top goalscorer and Tottenham Hotspur's all-time top goalscorer.
He won the Golden Boot at the 2018 World Cup, the Bundesliga with Bayern Munich in 2025 and 2026, and the 2026 Ballon d'Or.

Ibrahima Konaté.why: Ibrahima Konaté is a French centre-back who started his career at Sochaux and moved to Germany as a young player. He is tall, powerful and fast, so he can recover when an attacker gets past and win the ball back. He is strong in the air and on the ground. Kids can learn from his recovery runs; never stop chasing, because a fast defender can still save the day.

learn.text: Konaté uses his speed to get back. Practise a game where an attacker starts a few steps ahead of you, and race to get between them and the goal before they can shoot.

facts.text: With Liverpool he won the FA Cup in 2022 and the Premier League in 2024-25.

Jan Oblak.why: Jan Oblak is a Slovenian goalkeeper who left home young to play in Portugal and later became a long-serving number one for Atlético Madrid. He is known for his calm, steady positioning and huge reach, which make the goal look small. He rarely needs to make flashy dives. Kids can learn from his positioning; a keeper in the right place makes hard saves look easy.

learn.text: Oblak is almost always in the right spot. Practise moving along an imaginary line between the ball and the middle of your goal as a partner moves around the box, so you are ready for every shot.

facts.text: Oblak won the Ricardo Zamora Trophy for La Liga's best goalkeeper four seasons in a row from 2015-16, conceding a record low 18 league goals in the first.
With Atlético Madrid he won the Europa League in 2018 and La Liga in 2020-21.

Jeremie Frimpong.why: Jeremie Frimpong is a Dutch right-sided player who can play as a full-back or a winger. He is very fast and loves to attack, often making runs into the box like a forward. He grew up in Manchester's youth football before moving to Celtic and then Germany. Kids can learn from his energy; full-backs can be attackers too if they love to run.

learn.text: Frimpong arrives in the box from the right side. Practise sprinting forward from a full-back position, receiving a pass on the wing, then either crossing low or cutting inside to finish.

facts.text: As a young player Frimpong chose Manchester City's academy over Liverpool's because it was closer to home.
He won a Scottish treble with Celtic in 2019-20 and the Bundesliga and German Cup with Bayer Leverkusen in 2023-24.

João Neves.why: João Neves is a Portuguese midfielder who came through Benfica's youth system. He is small but tireless, winning the ball back, keeping it under pressure and passing forward quickly. He can play as a holding midfielder or further forward. Kids can learn from his energy and bravery; you do not need to be the biggest player to win the ball and run the game.

learn.text: Neves keeps the ball even when he is pressed. Practise a four-against-two rondo where you use one or two touches, keep your body open and move to give the passer an angle.

facts.text: Neves won the UEFA Youth League with Benfica in 2022, then the Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026.
He won the UEFA Nations League with Portugal in 2025.

Jude Bellingham.why: Jude Bellingham is an English midfielder who started at Birmingham City, moved to Borussia Dortmund as a teenager and later joined Real Madrid. He can defend, carry the ball forward, pass and arrive in the box to score. He is known for his leadership and his big-game goals. Kids can learn from his all-round game; try to be good at every part of football, not just one.

learn.text: Bellingham often receives the ball, turns and drives forward with it. Practise taking a pass, turning sharply away from a defender, then running with the ball at speed into the space in front of you.

facts.text: Birmingham City retired his number 22 shirt when he left, after only a short time in their first team, to inspire others.
Bellingham won La Liga and the Champions League with Real Madrid in 2023-24 and was named the competition's Young Player of the Season.

Jules Koundé.why: Jules Koundé is a French defender who began at Bordeaux and can play centre-back or right-back. He is quick, well-timed in the tackle and comfortable bringing the ball out from the back. He is not the tallest defender, but his speed and reading of the game make up for it. Kids can learn from his timing; a tackle at the right moment beats a big tackle at the wrong one.

learn.text: Koundé waits for the right moment to tackle. Practise a one-against-one where you jockey the attacker sideways, watch the ball, and only step in when the ball gets away from their feet.

facts.text: Koundé won the UEFA Europa League with Sevilla in 2020 and the UEFA Nations League with France in 2021.
With Barcelona he won La Liga three times, in 2022-23, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Julián Álvarez.why: Julián Álvarez is an Argentine forward who grew up in the small town of Calchín and joined River Plate's youth teams. He never stops running, pressing defenders and making runs in behind, and he finishes calmly. He can play as a striker or just behind one. Kids can learn from his pressing; a forward who chases every ball helps the whole team win it back.

learn.text: Álvarez presses defenders the moment they get the ball. Practise a chasing game where you close down the player with the ball quickly, cut off their easy pass, and try to win it back.

facts.text: Álvarez won the 2018 Copa Libertadores with River Plate, then the Champions League with Manchester City in 2023.
His nickname is La Araña, the spider, after his goal celebration. With Argentina he won the 2022 World Cup and the 2021 and 2024 Copa América.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.why: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is a Georgian winger who began at Dinamo Tbilisi and became a star in Italy and France. He loves to dribble from the left, using tricks and sudden changes of speed to beat defenders, and he can score and create. He is one of the most famous players Georgia has produced. Kids can learn from his creativity; try new tricks in practice so you have them ready in games.

learn.text: Kvaratskhelia keeps the ball very close when he dribbles. Practise weaving through a line of cones with small touches, using the inside and outside of both feet, then speed up after the last cone.

facts.text: Napoli fans nicknamed him Kvaradona, after Diego Maradona. In 2022-23 he helped Napoli win Serie A for the first time in 33 years.
He won the UEFA Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026.

Kylian Mbappé.why: Kylian Mbappé is a French forward who was raised in Bondy, near Paris, and began his senior career at Monaco. He is incredibly fast and finishes well with both feet, often running at defenders from the left before shooting. He has scored in the biggest games, including World Cup finals. Kids can learn from his speed with the ball; practise running fast while still keeping the ball under control.

learn.text: Mbappé sprints with the ball and still shoots accurately. Practise dribbling at speed towards goal, taking one small touch to set the ball, then shooting low into the corner without slowing down too much.

facts.text: At the 2018 World Cup he became the second teenager after Pelé to score in a World Cup final and win the tournament.
In the 2022 World Cup final he scored a hat-trick, only the second player to do that in a World Cup final.

Lamine Yamal.why: Lamine Yamal is a Spanish winger who grew up in Barcelona's La Masia academy. He likes to start on the right, cut inside onto his left foot and curl shots or passes with the outside of his boot. He plays with joy and imagination. Kids can learn from his fearless play; have fun with the ball, be creative, and do not be scared to try something new.

learn.text: Yamal is great at changing direction quickly. Practise dribbling through small gates of cones, using lots of small touches and sudden turns, and try finishing with a pass using the outside of your foot.

facts.text: At Euro 2024 he became the youngest player ever to score at a European Championship and won the Young Player award as Spain won the title.
He won the Kopa Trophy for the best young player in 2024, 2025 and 2026.

Lautaro Martínez.why: Lautaro Martínez is an Argentine striker who started at Racing Club and later became Inter Milan's captain. He is strong, brave and hard-working, and he can score with either foot or link play with his teammates. His nickname, El Toro, means the bull, because of his leadership and fighting spirit. Kids can learn from his never-give-up attitude; strikers who keep working get chances.

learn.text: Lautaro often works with a strike partner. Practise a two-against-one attack where you and a friend pass to draw the defender, then the free player finishes quickly.

facts.text: With Inter Milan he won Serie A in 2020-21, 2023-24 and 2025-26, and he was Serie A Footballer of the Year for 2024.
He won the Copa América with Argentina in 2021 and 2024, and was top scorer at the 2024 tournament.

Luis Díaz.why: Luis Díaz is a Colombian winger from Barrancas in La Guajira, where he learned to play at a small football school run by his father. He is quick, tricky and direct, and he loves to dribble at defenders from the left. He works hard to win the ball back too. Kids can learn from his energy; keep running at defenders and keep chasing when you lose the ball.

learn.text: Díaz loves to take on defenders. Practise one-against-one games where you try to dribble the ball into an end zone, using a fake one way and a burst of speed the other way.

facts.text: Díaz played for Colombia at the 2015 Copa Americana de Pueblos Indígenas, a tournament for indigenous players, because he is Wayuu.
He won the Premier League with Liverpool in 2024-25 and shared the Copa América Golden Boot in 2021.

Marquinhos.why: Marquinhos is a Brazilian centre-back who began at Corinthians and spent many years with Paris Saint-Germain, later as captain. He is not the biggest defender, but he is quick, clever and excellent at reading the game. He can also play in midfield. Kids can learn from his reading of the game; watch the ball and the attackers so you can step in before danger happens.

learn.text: Marquinhos is always talking to and covering his teammates. Practise a two-against-two game where you call 'press' or 'cover' so you and your partner always know who goes to the ball.

facts.text: He captained Paris Saint-Germain to their first Champions League titles, in 2025 and 2026.
Marquinhos won the 2012 Copa Libertadores with Corinthians, an Olympic gold medal with Brazil in 2016 and the 2019 Copa América.

Michael Olise.why: Michael Olise is a winger and attacking midfielder who grew up in London and was in Chelsea's academy as a boy, then made his name at Reading and Crystal Palace. He is left-footed and very clever with the ball, creating chances with passes, crosses and curling shots. He plays for France. Kids can learn from his calm on the ball; take your time and pick the clever pass.

learn.text: Olise delivers dangerous balls from the right with his left foot. Practise cutting inside from the wing and curling a cross or a pass towards a teammate running into the box.

facts.text: As a young boy at Chelsea's academy, Olise met Jamal Musiala, who was also there.
He won an Olympic silver medal with France in 2024 and the Bundesliga with Bayern Munich in 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Mike Maignan.why: Mike Maignan is a French goalkeeper who was born in French Guiana and grew up near Paris. He made his name at Lille before moving to AC Milan. He is athletic, brave and an excellent passer, often starting attacks with long kicks or throws. Kids can learn from his leadership; a goalkeeper who talks to the defence helps everyone stay organised.

learn.text: Maignan starts attacks with quick, accurate throws and kicks. Practise catching a shot, then quickly throwing or rolling the ball to a teammate who is running into space.

facts.text: Maignan won Ligue 1 with Lille in 2020-21, beating his former club Paris Saint-Germain to the title by one point on the final day.
He then won Serie A with AC Milan in 2021-22.

Mohamed Salah.why: Mohamed Salah is an Egyptian forward, nicknamed the Egyptian King, who began his career at Al-Mokawloon in Egypt. He plays mostly on the right, cutting inside onto his left foot to score. He is fast, clever and a fantastic finisher. He has become a hero to many children in Egypt and across Africa. Kids can learn from his finishing; stay calm, look at the goal and pick your spot.

learn.text: Salah often cuts inside from the right and curls the ball into the far corner. Practise dribbling inside from the wing and shooting across the goalkeeper with the inside of your foot.

facts.text: As of November 2026, Salah is the Premier League's all-time top foreign goalscorer and the Egypt national team's all-time top scorer.
With Liverpool he won the Premier League in 2019-20 and 2024-25, and he was African Footballer of the Year in 2017 and 2018.

Nico Williams.why: Nico Williams is a Spanish winger who came through Athletic Bilbao's youth academy. He is extremely fast and loves to run at defenders from the left, dribbling past them and crossing or shooting. When he reached the first team, his older brother Iñaki became his teammate. Kids can learn from his speed and confidence; when you have a defender one-on-one, attack them.

learn.text: Williams beats defenders with speed. Practise a one-against-one game with two small goals, pushing the ball past your defender into space and racing onto it before they can turn.

facts.text: He and his older brother Iñaki Williams won the Copa del Rey together with Athletic Bilbao in 2024.
With Spain he won Euro 2024 and the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Nuno Mendes.why: Nuno Mendes is a Portuguese left-back who came through Sporting CP's youth academy. He is very fast, strong on the ball and loves to dribble forward from defence. He can also defend fiercely against the quickest wingers. Kids can learn from his ball-carrying; full-backs can help attack by running forward with the ball when there is space.

learn.text: Mendes often wins the ball and drives forward. Practise winning a pass, then pushing the ball into space and running with it at speed, looking up for a teammate to pass to.

facts.text: He won the Portuguese league with Sporting CP in 2020-21, then the Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026.
He was named Player of the Tournament at the 2025 Nations League Finals, which Portugal won.

Ousmane Dembélé.why: Ousmane Dembélé is a French forward who began his career at Rennes. He is famous for being able to use both feet almost equally well, so defenders never know which way he will go. He is fast, tricky and can play on either wing or in the middle. Kids can learn from his two-footed skill; practise with your weaker foot every day.

learn.text: Dembélé uses both feet for everything. Practise toe taps, inside-outside touches and passes using your weaker foot as often as your stronger foot, until both feel natural.

facts.text: Dembélé won the Ballon d'Or and The Best FIFA Men's Player award for 2025.
He won the UEFA Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026, after earlier league titles in Germany and Spain.

Pau Cubarsí.why: Pau Cubarsí is a Spanish centre-back who played in Girona's youth teams before moving to Barcelona's La Masia academy. He is known for his calm passing from defence, often playing the ball forward through lines of opponents. He also reads the game cleverly. Kids can learn from his passing; defenders who pass well help their team start every attack.

learn.text: Cubarsí likes to pass forward from the back. Practise a build-out game where you receive from the keeper and look for a pass between two opponents to a teammate further up the pitch.

facts.text: Cubarsí won Olympic gold with Spain in 2024 and was part of the Spain team that won the 2026 World Cup, where he got the Young Player award.
With Barcelona he won La Liga in 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Pedri.why: Pedri is a Spanish midfielder from Tenerife in the Canary Islands who came through Las Palmas's youth system before moving to Barcelona. He controls games with clever touches, quick turns and smart passes, and he rarely gives the ball away. His father played as a goalkeeper when he was young. Kids can learn from his close control; keep the ball near your feet and your head up.

learn.text: Pedri always finds a way out of pressure. Practise a three-against-one rondo where you use one or two touches, open your body before the ball arrives and pass to the free teammate.

facts.text: Pedri was named Young Player of the Tournament at Euro 2020 and won the Kopa Trophy in 2021.
He won Euro 2024 and the 2026 World Cup with Spain.

Pedro Porro.why: Pedro Porro is a Spanish right-back who started at Girona's reserve team before playing in Spain, Portugal and England. He loves to attack, delivering crosses and set pieces, and he can score spectacular goals. Kids can learn from his crossing; a good cross can turn a full-back into a goal-maker.

learn.text: Porro whips in crosses from the right. Practise running onto a pass down the wing, looking up to see where your teammates are, then crossing the ball into the space in front of them.

facts.text: Porro won the Portuguese league with Sporting CP in 2020-21 and the UEFA Europa League with Tottenham Hotspur in 2025.
He was part of the Spain squad that won the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Raphinha.why: Raphinha is a Brazilian forward who grew up in Restinga, a poor neighbourhood far from the centre of Porto Alegre. As a teenager he played in local community tournaments before getting his chance in Portugal. He is left-footed, quick and dangerous from free kicks and long shots, and he works hard for his team. Kids can learn from his determination; keep playing wherever you can.

learn.text: Raphinha loves to shoot with his left foot. Practise taking one touch to set the ball, then striking with your laces through the middle of the ball so it flies straight and hard at the target.

facts.text: As a teenager Raphinha played in the várzea tournaments around Porto Alegre, local community games that anyone could join.
He won La Liga with Barcelona in 2022-23, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Robert Lewandowski.why: Robert Lewandowski is a Polish striker who worked his way up from smaller Polish clubs to the very top of European football. He is famous for his finishing, his movement in the box and his fitness, which helped him keep scoring for many seasons. Kids can learn from his habits; looking after your body with good food, sleep and training helps you keep improving for years.

learn.text: Lewandowski is always in the right place in the box. Practise moving to find space as the ball comes in, then finishing first time, and following every shot in case of a rebound.

facts.text: In 2015 he came on as a substitute for Bayern Munich and scored five goals in under nine minutes, the fastest ever in the Bundesliga.
He won the Champions League with Bayern in 2020 and The Best FIFA Men's Player award in 2020 and 2021.

Rodri.why: Rodri is a Spanish defensive midfielder who began at Villarreal and later starred for Atlético Madrid and Manchester City. He sits in front of the defence, wins the ball, keeps it simple and controls the speed of the game with calm passing. He is also known for scoring important goals from outside the box. Kids can learn from his calm; a holding midfielder who never panics makes the whole team feel safe.

learn.text: Rodri keeps the ball moving with short, simple passes. Practise passing in a triangle with two friends, moving after every pass so there is always a clear angle, and try to use only two touches.

facts.text: Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or and was named Player of the Tournament at Euro 2024, which Spain won.
He scored the winning goal as Manchester City won the 2023 Champions League, and he won the Golden Ball at the 2026 World Cup.

Rúben Dias.why: Rúben Dias is a Portuguese centre-back who came through Benfica's youth academy. He is a strong, vocal leader who organises the defence, blocks shots and wins duels. He also passes well from the back. He helped Manchester City win four Premier League titles in a row. Kids can learn from his leadership; talk to your teammates all game, so everyone knows where to be.

learn.text: Dias is always organising the players around him. Practise a two-against-two game where the covering defender talks the whole time, telling the pressing defender which way to show the attacker.

facts.text: In his first season in England, 2020-21, Dias was named FWA Footballer of the Year and won the Premier League with Manchester City.
He won the UEFA Nations League with Portugal in 2019 and again in 2025.

Theo Hernández.why: Theo Hernández is a French left-back known for his long, powerful runs forward with the ball. He can carry it from his own half to the opponents' box and finish the move himself. He comes from a football family; his father was a footballer and his older brother Lucas is a professional too. Kids can learn from his bravery on the ball; if there is space ahead of you, run into it.

learn.text: Theo loves to win the ball and charge forward. Practise picking up a loose ball, turning towards the other goal and running with big pushes of the ball into open space.

facts.text: Theo is the younger brother of Lucas Hernandez, who is also a professional footballer, and the son of a former player.
He won the Champions League with Real Madrid in 2018 and Serie A with AC Milan in 2021-22.

Thibaut Courtois.why: Thibaut Courtois is a Belgian goalkeeper who began at Genk and later played for Atlético Madrid, Chelsea and Real Madrid. He is very tall, with a huge reach, and he uses it to make the goal look small. He is calm and makes difficult saves look simple. Kids can learn from his reach and footwork; stay big, stay balanced and move your feet before you dive.

learn.text: Courtois gets his feet set before every save. Practise side-steps across your goal, stopping in a ready position with knees bent and hands out, then saving a shot to each side.

facts.text: Courtois won the Golden Glove at the 2018 World Cup, where Belgium finished third, their best ever World Cup finish.
In the 2022 Champions League final he made nine saves and was player of the match as Real Madrid beat Liverpool.

Trent Alexander-Arnold.why: Trent Alexander-Arnold is an English defender from West Derby in Liverpool who joined Liverpool's academy as a young boy. He is famous for his passing, his crossing and his set pieces, and he can play at right-back or in midfield. He can switch play with long, accurate passes. Kids can learn from his range of passing; practise passing long as well as short.

learn.text: Alexander-Arnold can hit long passes with great accuracy. Practise passing to a partner through cone gates, starting close and moving further apart as you get better, keeping the ball low and on target.

facts.text: He was spotted at a school football camp, where his name was drawn from a hat to attend, and joined Liverpool's academy in 2004.
With Liverpool he won the Champions League in 2019 and the Premier League in 2019-20 and 2024-25.

Victor Osimhen.why: Victor Osimhen is a Nigerian striker who was born in Lagos, the youngest of seven children. He is fast and powerful, he attacks the space behind defenders and he never stops chasing. He became a big star in Italy, helping Napoli to a famous title. Kids can learn from his hunger; strikers who chase every ball and attack every cross score lots of goals.

learn.text: Osimhen is always first to loose balls in the box. Practise a game where after every shot you and a partner race in to win the rebound and finish it.

facts.text: Osimhen won the 2015 FIFA Under-17 World Cup with Nigeria and was the tournament's top scorer.
He won Serie A with Napoli in 2022-23 and was named African Footballer of the Year for 2023.

Viktor Gyökeres.why: Viktor Gyökeres is a Swedish striker who began at IF Brommapojkarna and played in Germany and England's second tier before becoming a star at Sporting CP. He is strong, fast and direct, and he loves to run at defenders and shoot. His path shows that late bloomers can reach the top. Kids can learn from his persistence; keep working, and your best years can still be ahead.

learn.text: Gyökeres runs hard at the defence with the ball. Practise dribbling forward at speed, shielding the ball with your body if a defender gets close, and finishing with a strong, low shot.

facts.text: Gyökeres celebrates his goals by crossing both hands over his mouth, like a mask.
He was named Primeira Liga Player of the Year twice with Sporting CP, for 2023-24 and 2024-25.

Vinícius Júnior.why: Vinícius Júnior is a Brazilian winger from São Gonçalo who started his professional career at Flamengo. He is lightning fast and very skilful, beating defenders with stepovers, feints and sudden bursts of speed from the left. He plays with joy and brings fans to their feet. Kids can learn from his flair; practise your skills often so you can use them in games with confidence.

learn.text: Vinícius beats defenders with a fake and a burst of speed. Practise a one-against-one game where you show the defender one way, then accelerate past on the other side into the end zone.

facts.text: Vinícius won the Champions League with Real Madrid in 2022 and 2024, and was the competition's Young Player of the Season for 2021-22.
He was given the Golden Ball at the 2022 FIFA Club World Cup and the 2024 FIFA Intercontinental Cup.

Virgil van Dijk.why: Virgil van Dijk is a Dutch centre-back who joined Willem II's academy as a boy and later became captain of Liverpool and the Netherlands. He is tall, calm, fast and very hard to dribble past. He rarely dives into tackles, preferring to stay on his feet and guide attackers away. Kids can learn from his patience; stay calm and do not rush the tackle.

learn.text: Van Dijk stays on his feet and waits. Practise defending a one-against-one by staying side-on, keeping a short distance from the attacker and only tackling when you are sure you can win the ball.

facts.text: While at the Willem II academy as a teenager, Van Dijk also had a part-time job washing dishes.
He was named UEFA Men's Player of the Year for 2018-19 and won the Premier League with Liverpool in 2019-20 and 2024-25.

Vitinha.why: Vitinha is a Portuguese midfielder who came through Porto's youth teams. He is small but brilliant at controlling the game, receiving under pressure, turning and passing to keep his team moving forward. He rarely loses the ball. Kids can learn from his close control; you do not need to be tall to run a midfield if your touch and thinking are quick.

learn.text: Vitinha always gets out of tight spaces. Practise a three-against-one rondo where you take one touch to open your body, then pass away from the defender to the free player.

facts.text: Vitinha won the UEFA Youth League with Porto in 2019, and later the Champions League with Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 and 2026.
He finished third in the 2025 Ballon d'Or and won the 2025 Nations League with Portugal.

William Saliba.why: William Saliba is a French centre-back who was born in Bondy, near Paris, and started his career at Saint-Étienne. He is calm, quick and strong, and he hardly ever looks rushed. He also brings the ball out from the back with confidence. Kids can learn from his calm defending; stay relaxed and focused, and you will make better decisions.

learn.text: Saliba stays between the attacker and the goal. Practise a game where an attacker starts with the ball, and you move quickly to get goal-side, then show them away from the middle.

facts.text: Saliba won the FA Community Shield with Arsenal in 2020 and 2023, and the Premier League with them in 2025-26.
He has a Lebanese father and a Cameroonian mother, and he chose to represent France.

Yassine Bounou.why: Yassine Bounou, known as Bono, is a Moroccan goalkeeper who was born in Montreal, Canada, and moved to Morocco with his family when he was very small. He is calm, agile and good with his feet. He became a hero when Morocco reached the World Cup semi-finals in 2022. Kids can learn from his calm in penalty shootouts; wait as long as you can before moving.

learn.text: Bono stays patient against shooters. Practise facing a dribbler one-on-one, holding your position and staying on your feet until the shot comes, then reacting quickly.

facts.text: Bounou won the UEFA Europa League with Sevilla twice, in 2020 and 2023.
He won the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations with Morocco and the tournament's Golden Glove.

Marc-André ter Stegen.why: Marc-André ter Stegen is a German goalkeeper who began at Borussia Mönchengladbach and spent many years at Barcelona. He is famous for his footwork; he passes almost like an outfield player and helps his team keep the ball. He is also an excellent shot-stopper. Kids can learn from his passing; goalkeepers should practise with their feet as much as their hands.

learn.text: Ter Stegen plays calm passes under pressure. Practise receiving back-passes with both feet, taking a touch away from an attacker, and passing accurately to a teammate on either side.

facts.text: Ter Stegen won the European Under-17 Championship with Germany in 2009 and the Confederations Cup in 2017.
With Barcelona he won the Champions League in 2015 and La Liga seven times.

Ederson.why: Ederson is a Brazilian goalkeeper who made his name in Portugal with Rio Ave and Benfica before Manchester City. He is famous for his kicking, which can reach the other end of the pitch, and for his calm passing under pressure. He changed what people expect from a goalkeeper. Kids can learn from his kicking; practise long and short kicks, not only saves.

learn.text: Ederson can start an attack with one kick. Practise kicking the ball from your hands and from the ground to a teammate, aiming for their feet or the space in front of them.

facts.text: In 2018 Ederson became the first Manchester City goalkeeper to set up a Premier League goal, when Sergio Agüero scored from his goal kick.
He won the Premier League Golden Glove three seasons in a row from 2019-20, and The Best FIFA Goalkeeper award for 2023.

Jordan Pickford.why: Jordan Pickford is an English goalkeeper who joined Sunderland's academy at the age of eight. He went on loan to many smaller clubs, learning in tough leagues, before becoming England's number one. He is quick, brave and full of energy, and he is very good with his feet. Kids can learn from his journey; every game, at any level, is a chance to learn.

learn.text: Pickford is sharp and quick on his line. Practise catching quick shots from close range, with your hands in a W shape for high balls and a basket shape for low balls.

facts.text: Pickford played for Sunderland's academy, reserve and senior teams, with loans at six other clubs before he joined Everton.
He won the Toulon Tournament with England Under-21s in 2016 and was England Under-21 Player of the Year for 2017.

Andrew Robertson.why: Andrew Robertson is a Scottish left-back who started his senior career at Queen's Park, which was then an amateur club. He worked his way up through Dundee United and Hull City to become a Liverpool regular and Scotland's captain. He is tireless, attacks down the left and delivers great crosses. Kids can learn from his journey; even if you start small, hard work can take you far.

learn.text: Robertson overlaps and crosses from the left. Practise sprinting down the wing, taking the pass in your stride and crossing early, before the defence has time to get set.

facts.text: Robertson began his senior career with one season at Queen's Park, then an amateur club, in 2012.
Robertson won the 2019 Champions League with Liverpool, plus Premier League titles in 2019-20 and 2024-25.

Reece James.why: Reece James is an English right-back who came through Chelsea's academy. He is strong, powerful and a great crosser, and he can also play in midfield. He is known for his excellent free kicks and long passes. Kids can learn from his technique when striking the ball; practise passing, crossing and shooting with good technique.

learn.text: James delivers whipped crosses from the right. Practise crossing a moving ball into the box from the wing, aiming between the goalkeeper and the defenders.

facts.text: As a youth player at Chelsea, James won the FA Youth Cup twice, in 2017 and 2018, and the 2017 European Under-19 Championship with England.
With Chelsea he won the Champions League in 2021 and the Conference League in 2025.

Joško Gvardiol.why: Joško Gvardiol is a Croatian defender who came through Dinamo Zagreb and can play centre-back or left-back. He is strong, fast and left-footed, and he loves to carry the ball forward and even score. At the 2022 World Cup he wore a protective face mask after breaking his nose. Kids can learn from his confidence on the ball; defenders can attack too.

learn.text: Gvardiol carries the ball out from defence. Practise receiving the ball, looking up, then pushing forward into space with long touches while scanning for a pass.

facts.text: He won the Croatian league twice with Dinamo Zagreb and the German Cup twice with RB Leipzig.
Gvardiol won the Premier League with Manchester City in 2023-24.

Kim Min-jae.why: Kim Min-jae is a South Korean centre-back who started in the Korean league with Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors. He is tall, quick and strong, and he is famous for winning the ball back and stepping forward with it. He became a star in Italy and Germany. Kids can learn from his concentration; good defenders are always switched on, even when the ball is far away.

learn.text: Kim steps forward to win the ball when it is safe. Practise a two-against-two where one defender steps in to intercept as the other covers, then switch roles.

facts.text: Kim won the K League 1 with Jeonbuk in 2017 and 2018 and a gold medal at the 2018 Asian Games.
He won Serie A with Napoli in 2022-23 and the Bundesliga with Bayern Munich in 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Kevin De Bruyne.why: Kevin De Bruyne is a Belgian midfielder who began at his hometown club Drongen before joining Gent and Genk. He is famous for his passing, which can split any defence, and for his powerful shots from distance. He hits the ball well with both feet. Kids can learn from his early coaching; his youth coaches focused on technique, basics and passing.

learn.text: De Bruyne often plays a quick one-two then a killer pass. Practise a give-and-go with a partner, then look up immediately to pass into the space behind a defender.

facts.text: De Bruyne was the first player to reach 20 assists in a single season in two of Europe's top five leagues.
He won six Premier League titles with Manchester City and was Bundesliga Player of the Year for 2014-15 with VfL Wolfsburg.

Jamal Musiala.why: Jamal Musiala is a German attacking midfielder who spent much of his childhood in England and was part of Chelsea's academy before moving to Bayern Munich. He glides past defenders with tiny touches and sudden changes of direction, keeping the ball glued to his feet in tight spaces. Kids can learn from his close control; the more touches you take in practice, the easier dribbling becomes.

learn.text: Musiala dribbles through crowds with very small touches. Practise dribbling in a crowded square, keeping the ball within a step of your feet and using your body to swerve past other players.

facts.text: Musiala played youth football for both England and Germany before choosing to play for Germany's senior team.
He won the Champions League with Bayern Munich in 2020 and was named Germany's Player of the Year in 2022 and 2024.

Martin Ødegaard.why: Martin Ødegaard is a Norwegian playmaker who started his senior career at Strømsgodset as a young teenager and later captained Arsenal. He is a clever passer and a hard worker who leads the team's pressing. After a tough spell with little playing time, he went on loan to several clubs and came back stronger. Kids can learn from his resilience; setbacks can make you better.

learn.text: Ødegaard loves quick one-twos around the box. Practise passing to a partner, sprinting past a cone, and receiving the return pass in your stride before passing or shooting.

facts.text: At Strømsgodset he became the youngest goalscorer in the history of Norway's top league.
He won the Copa del Rey with Real Sociedad in 2020 and the Premier League with Arsenal in 2025-26.

Neymar.why: Neymar is a Brazilian forward who came through Santos, the club where Pelé once played. He is one of the most skilful dribblers of his generation, famous for tricks, flicks and fearless one-on-ones. He has also set up many goals for teammates. Kids can learn from his creativity; practise your tricks and play with joy, but always look for the teammate who is free.

learn.text: Neymar loves to take on defenders with tricks. Practise a one-against-one with two small goals, trying a stepover or a drag-back to get past, then score in either goal.

facts.text: As of November 2026, Neymar is the Brazil national team's all-time top goalscorer and top assist provider.
He won the Copa Libertadores with Santos in 2011, the Champions League with Barcelona in 2015 and Olympic gold with Brazil in 2016.

Son Heung-min.why: Son Heung-min is a South Korean forward who moved to Germany as a teenager and later became a star at Tottenham Hotspur. He is fast, uses both feet equally well and finishes calmly. He is known for his big smile and kindness on and off the pitch. Kids can learn from his two-footed shooting; practise finishing with both feet, so you can shoot whichever way the ball comes.

learn.text: Son can shoot with either foot. Practise a shooting game where you alternate feet every turn, striking low towards the corners and following through towards the target.

facts.text: Son won the FIFA Puskás Award for a solo goal he scored for Tottenham in 2019-20.
In 2021-22 he shared the Premier League Golden Boot, the first Asian player to win it, and in 2025 he won the Europa League.

Christian Pulisic.why: Christian Pulisic is an American attacking player who was born and raised in Hershey, Pennsylvania, and moved to Borussia Dortmund's youth academy as a teenager. He is quick, direct and loves to dribble at defenders and shoot. He is nicknamed Captain America. Kids can learn from his directness; when you get the ball near goal, attack the space and look to score.

learn.text: Pulisic drives at defenders and gets his shot away quickly. Practise dribbling at a cone defender, shifting the ball sideways with one touch, then shooting before the defender can recover.

facts.text: Pulisic won the Champions League with Chelsea in 2021, as part of a squad that also won the UEFA Super Cup and the Club World Cup.
He won the CONCACAF Nations League with the United States three times.

Karim Benzema.why: Karim Benzema is a French striker who began at his hometown club Bron Terraillon, joined Lyon as a boy and later spent many years at Real Madrid. He is more than a goalscorer; he links play, drops deep to help build attacks and makes his teammates better. Later in his career he became the main goalscorer and won the biggest individual prize. Kids can learn from his teamwork; a striker who passes well makes the whole team better.

learn.text: Benzema often drops deep and plays clever passes. Practise receiving with your back to goal, laying the ball off to a teammate, then running into the box for the return.

facts.text: Benzema won the Ballon d'Or for 2022, the fifth French player to win it.
With Real Madrid he won the Champions League five times, and with Lyon he won four French league titles in a row.

Antoine Griezmann.why: Antoine Griezmann is a French forward from Mâcon who was turned down by several clubs as a boy, including Lyon, because of his small frame. He got his chance at Real Sociedad in Spain instead. He became a clever, hard-working forward who can score, create and defend. Kids can learn from his determination; if one club says no, keep working and find another way.

learn.text: Griezmann links with teammates and then attacks the box. Practise a one-two with a partner, then sprint into space for a shot as soon as you get the ball back.

facts.text: Griezmann was Player of the Tournament and top scorer at Euro 2016.
He was player of the match in the 2018 World Cup final as France won the tournament.

Romelu Lukaku.why: Romelu Lukaku is a Belgian striker who began his professional career at Anderlecht. He is big, strong and powerful, and he uses his body to hold off defenders, then turns or lays the ball off. He also has a lot of pace for a big striker. Kids can learn from his strength on the ball; use your body to protect the ball from defenders.

learn.text: Lukaku holds the ball up with his back to goal. Practise shielding the ball from a defender with your body, then passing back to a teammate who runs on to shoot.

facts.text: As of November 2026, Lukaku is Belgium's all-time top goalscorer.
He won Serie A twice, with Inter Milan in 2020-21 and with Napoli in 2024-25, and was Serie A Footballer of the Year for 2021.

Aitana Bonmatí.why: Aitana Bonmatí is a Spanish midfielder from Catalonia who came through Barcelona's youth teams. She is small but brilliant, with quick feet, clever passing and great vision, and she presses hard to win the ball back. She has won almost every honour in the game. Kids can learn from her quick thinking; look around before the ball comes so you know where to go next.

learn.text: Aitana always knows what is around her. Practise looking over both shoulders while the ball is on its way, then use your first touch to move away from pressure towards space.

facts.text: Aitana won the 2023 Women's World Cup with Spain and the Golden Ball as the tournament's best player.
She won the Ballon d'Or Féminin in 2023, 2024 and 2025, the first player to win it three times in a row.

Alexia Putellas.why: Alexia Putellas is a Spanish midfielder from Catalonia who played for Espanyol and Levante before becoming a legend at Barcelona. She is a skilful, elegant player who scores, creates and leads. She helped make Barcelona one of the strongest women's teams in the world. Kids can learn from her leadership; help your teammates, and lead by working hard.

learn.text: Alexia receives the ball on the half-turn so she can play forward. Practise receiving a pass across your body with your back foot, opening up to face the field, then passing forward.

facts.text: In 2021 Alexia became the first player to win the UEFA Women's Player of the Year, the Ballon d'Or Féminin and The Best FIFA Women's Player in the same year.
She won the Women's Champions League with Barcelona in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.

Mariona Caldentey.why: Mariona Caldentey is a Spanish attacking player born in Felanitx, on the island of Mallorca, where her father was a football coach. She spent ten years at Barcelona and later moved to Arsenal. She is clever, technical and calm in front of goal, and she can play on the wing or in the middle. Kids can learn from her versatility; be ready to help your team in different positions.

learn.text: Mariona finds space between the lines and turns. Practise checking your shoulder, receiving with the foot furthest from the defender, and turning to face goal in one smooth move.

facts.text: Her long-range curler against Lyon in the 2024-25 Champions League semi-final was voted Goal of the Tournament, and Arsenal went on to win the final.
She won the Women's Champions League three times with Barcelona, in 2021, 2023 and 2024.

Patri Guijarro.why: Patri Guijarro is a Spanish midfielder who moved to Barcelona from UD Collerense in 2015. She is a holding midfielder who keeps the team balanced, wins the ball and passes simply. She can also arrive in the box to score. Kids can learn from her balance; a good midfielder knows when to attack and when to stay back and protect the defence.

learn.text: Guijarro keeps the ball moving with simple passes. Practise passing around a triangle with two teammates, using your first touch to set up your next pass.

facts.text: At the 2018 Under-20 Women's World Cup she won both the Golden Ball and the Golden Boot.
Guijarro won the UEFA Women's Under-17 Championship with Spain in 2015, and four Champions League titles with Barcelona.

Lindsey Heaps.why: Lindsey Heaps, known earlier in her career as Lindsey Horan, is an American midfielder who grew up in Golden, Colorado. She chose to turn professional with Paris Saint-Germain instead of going to college, even though she had a college scholarship. She is strong, skilful and a natural leader. Kids can learn from her bravery in making her own path; believe in your choices.

learn.text: Heaps controls the middle of the pitch. Practise a four-against-two rondo where you keep the ball moving with quick passes and always make an angle for the player on the ball.

facts.text: Heaps won the 2019 Women's World Cup with the United States and captained them to Olympic gold in Paris in 2024.
She won the Women's Champions League with Lyon in 2022.

Hannah Hampton.why: Hannah Hampton is an English goalkeeper born in Birmingham who spent five years of her childhood in Spain, playing in Villarreal's youth team. She is very good with her feet, which she first learned as an outfield player, and she is a confident shot-stopper. Kids can learn from her path; trying different positions when you are young can help you later.

learn.text: Hampton passes accurately with both feet. Practise receiving a back-pass and passing to a teammate on either side, keeping your head up so you can see where the free player is.

facts.text: Hampton won the European Championship with England in 2022 and 2025.
She won the Yashin Trophy and The Best FIFA Women's Goalkeeper award for 2025.

Mary Earps.why: Mary Earps is an English goalkeeper who played for many clubs, including VfL Wolfsburg in Germany, before becoming England's number one. She is brave and agile, and she kept working her way up, club by club, from the lower levels. Kids can learn from her resilience; keep believing in yourself and keep training, even when things are tough.

learn.text: Earps reads where the shooter wants to go. Practise facing shots from different angles, moving forward to make the goal smaller, and staying on your feet as long as possible.

facts.text: Earps won the Golden Glove at the 2023 Women's World Cup and was BBC Women's Footballer of the Year for 2023.
She won the 2022 European Championship with England and The Best FIFA Women's Goalkeeper award in 2022 and 2023.

Alyssa Naeher.why: Alyssa Naeher is an American goalkeeper who was the United States number one for many years. She is calm, brave and excellent in penalty shootouts. She was part of two World Cup-winning teams. Kids can learn from her calm; a goalkeeper who stays relaxed helps the whole team feel confident.

learn.text: Naeher is always set and balanced before a shot. Practise stepping into a ready position with your weight on the balls of your feet, then diving to save shots on both sides.

facts.text: Naeher won the Women's World Cup with the United States in 2015 and 2019, and Olympic gold in 2024.
At the 2020 Olympics she saved three penalties against the Netherlands, one in normal time and two in the shootout, to reach the semi-finals.

Lucy Bronze.why: Lucy Bronze is an English right-back who played college football in the United States before returning to England. She is strong, fast and fearless, and she loves to attack down the wing and score big goals. She has won trophies in England, France and Spain. Kids can learn from her drive; keep pushing yourself to improve and to be brave in every game.

learn.text: Bronze overlaps down the right and gets into the box. Practise running past a teammate on the outside, receiving the ball and crossing low, or cutting in to shoot.

facts.text: Bronze was named The Best FIFA Women's Player for 2020.
She won five Women's Champions League titles, three with Lyon and two with Barcelona, plus Euro 2022 and Euro 2025 with England.

Wendie Renard.why: Wendie Renard is a French centre-back born in Martinique, a French island in the Caribbean. She moved to France to join Lyon and spent her whole career there. She is very tall and strong in duels, and she reads the game well. She is one of the most successful players in club football. Kids can learn from her loyalty and leadership; be someone your team can rely on.

learn.text: Renard uses her reach to win the ball. Practise defending one-against-one, staying close enough to the attacker to stretch out and poke the ball away when they take a big touch.

facts.text: As of November 2026, Renard has won a record 18 French league titles and eight European Cups with Lyon.

Leah Williamson.why: Leah Williamson is an English defender who came through Arsenal's academy and spent her whole career there. She is calm on the ball and passes well from the back, and she can also play in midfield. She became England's captain and led them to their first major women's title. Kids can learn from her calm leadership; stay composed and help your teammates.

learn.text: Williamson starts attacks with calm passes. Practise a build-out game where defenders receive from the keeper and pass forward through the lines, keeping the ball on the ground.

facts.text: Williamson captained England to their first European Championship title in 2022, and they won it again in 2025.
She won the Women's Champions League with Arsenal in 2025.

Mapi León.why: Mapi León is a Spanish defender who began at her hometown club Prainsa Zaragoza. She started as a left-back and became a centre-back at Atlético Madrid. She is known for her accurate passing from defence, which helps her team start attacks. Kids can learn from her passing; defenders who pass well help the team keep the ball.

learn.text: León passes the ball accurately from the back. Practise passing through cone gates with a partner, using the inside of your foot and aiming for your partner's front foot.

facts.text: In 2017 León became the first paid transfer in Spanish women's football history, when she moved from Atlético Madrid to Barcelona.
With Barcelona she won the Women's Champions League in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.
